<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Participant_INQ" targetRef="StartEvent_DataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Transmission" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitData" targetRef="Participant_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="SendTask_RejectRequest" targetRef="Participant_INQ"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DataRequest" messageRef="Message_DataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToExamination</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Examination" name="Examination outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToExamination</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accepted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TransmitData" name="Transmit data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accepted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEndTransmitted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RejectRequest" name="Reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEndRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEndTransmitted</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEndRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_DataRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToExamination" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Examination"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Request examined positively" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination" targetRef="SendTask_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Request examined negatively" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination" targetRef="SendTask_RejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEndTransmitted" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitData" targetRef="EndEvent_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEndRejected" sourceRef="SendTask_RejectRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_DataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DataTransmitted" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="Participant_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestRejected" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_RejectRequest" targetRef="Participant_INQ"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ process" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_ToSend</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_ToSend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_INQ" name="Request transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_ToSend" sourceRef="StartEvent_INQ" targetRef="SendTask_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_ToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_INQ"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DataRequest" messageRef="Message_DataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check request">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejection</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Transmission</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TransmitToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectRequest" name="Reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TransmitToEnd</bpmn:incoming>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request" messageRef="Message_DataRequest" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data" messageRef="Message_DataTransmission" sourceRef="SendTask_AnswerData" targetRef="Participant_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection" sourceRef="SendTask_AnswerRejection" targetRef="Participant_INQ"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_INQ" name="Data request needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_INQ_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request" messageRef="Message_DataRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_INQ_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_INQ_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestTransmitted" name="Data request transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_INQ_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_INQ_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_INQ" targetRef="SendTask_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_INQ_2" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestTransmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_IP_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_DataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CheckRequest" name="Check request">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_IP_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_IP_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Examination_Split" name="Examination outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_IP_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_IP_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_IP_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_AnswerData" name="Answer INQ: transmit data" messageRef="Message_DataTransmission">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_IP_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_IP_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_AnswerRejection" name="Answer INQ: reject request" messageRef="Message_Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_IP_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_IP_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataTransmitted" name="Transmission of data">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_IP_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_IP_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_IP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="UserTask_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_IP_2" sourceRef="UserTask_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Examination_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_IP_3" name="Examination positive" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination_Split" targetRef="SendTask_AnswerData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_IP_4" name="Examination negative" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination_Split" targetRef="SendTask_AnswerRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_IP_5" sourceRef="SendTask_AnswerData" targetRef="EndEvent_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_IP_6" sourceRef="SendTask_AnswerRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs an action on a request received from another participant (such as checking, examining or answering it), and the action leads to several stated alternative results, without stating that a message is sent for each result: Model the participant's action as one plain task in that participant's pool or lane, labeled with the description's own verb and object, and placed where the description places it. Model the alternative results as the outgoing branches of an exclusive gateway after that task, each branch leading to its own outcome. Do not create one send task per alternative result, and do not replace the action with a start event.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant performs an action on a request received from another participant (such as checking, examining or answering it), and the action leads to several stated alternative results, without stating that a message is sent for each result

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant sends a document or request to a different participant, and that the receiving participant then reviews it and makes a decision with named outcomes: Model the sending as a send task in the sender's pool, connected by a message flow to the receiver's pool. Model the receiver's review as a task in the receiver's pool, placed after the message is received. Model the decision as an exclusive gateway with one conditional outgoing flow per named outcome, and give each outcome its own task in the receiver's pool. Do not replace the sending or the review with an unrelated user task in the sender's pool.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant sends a request to another participant, that the receiving participant checks it, and that the receiving participant then replies with one of several named outcomes, each named outcome being the content of that reply

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant personally carries out an action, such as a request, a review, an evaluation, or a delivery step, and does not say that a message is sent to another participant as the unit of work: Model that action as a user task performed by the responsible participant, not as a send task. Reserve a send task for cases where transmitting a message is itself the modeled work. Make sure each such action appears as its own task in the sequence where the description places it.
rules.situation: the description lists several consecutive sentences in which one participant performs its own actions (for example transmitting, checking, or answering), and each action is stated as a separate sentence with its own verb

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant sends a decision or document to another participant, and a later activity of the receiving participant acts on it: Model the sending as an explicit task in the sender's pool or lane, placed before the receiver's activity. If the receiver belongs to a different participant, connect the sending task to the receiving side with a message flow. Do not omit the sending step or reduce it to an implicit message flow.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant sends a request to another participant, the receiving participant then performs a stated check on it, and afterwards gives a reply with several named alternative results

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant sends a request to another participant, that the receiving participant examines the request, and that it then gives an answer to the request that depends on the examination outcome, with each outcome described as its own answer: Model the sending of the request as its own task in the sender's pool or lane, placed before the receiver's examination, and connect it to the receiver with a message flow. Model the examination as one task in the receiver's pool. After it, place an exclusive gateway on the examination outcome. Model each stated answer as its own task in the receiver's pool on the gateway branch that leads to it, labeled with the description's verb and object, and let the branch continue from that answer task. Do not replace the sending step with a start event that only names receipt, and do not end a branch at an end event or a bare flow label without the stated answer task.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant sends a request to another participant, that the receiving participant examines the request, and that it then gives an answer to the request that depends on the examination outcome, with each outcome described as its own answer
